purpose: Fresh independent blind fixture for short natural-language concept intents on inspected implementation owners.
source_basis: Dirty tracked source snapshot with seven truthful owned API documentation updates; source_head identifies only the base Git commit, not the complete source bytes. File digests bind inspected owners and the recorded source-tree digest binds the common corpus.

provenance.authorship: model-authored local purposive sample; not human gold
provenance.author_role: independent fixture author blind to the proposed retrieval policy and new retrieval outputs
provenance.source_tree_binding_basis: Common-corpus digest supplied by the coordinating agent in /private/tmp/mastermind-concept-repair-path.json; owner file digests independently recomputed and unchanged.
provenance.inspected_prior_material: Existing concept-relevance fixture case ids, query text and path/symbol anchors only, for novelty; fixture README and evaluator format contract.
provenance.freeze_contract: Queries, ids, kinds, splits, top limits and path/symbol judgments were frozen before any retrieval result. Only source bindings and exact line locations may be rebound before first output if owner documentation changes without changing these intents or anchors.
provenance.query_anchor_digest_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, non-ASCII preserved; array in case order with id, split, kind, query, top and relevant/distractors path/symbol pairs only.

source_rebinding.basis: prior frozen corpus plus seven truthful owned API documentation updates; both variants use identical source and index
source_rebinding.source_head_meaning: base commit only; common corpus includes dirty tracked documentation changes

selection.method: Purposive source-owner inspection, with short ordinary lowercase queries; no aliases, result-guided selection or query tuning.
selection.novelty: Selected fresh owners and operations absent from the inspected observed fixture ids, queries and relevant anchors.
selection.scope: One repository; local useful navigation intents from ten implementation responsibilities. Negative operations are plausible adjacent capabilities unsupported by the inspected owners.
limitations: Model judgments are sparse source anchors, not exhaustive relevance labels.
This is not a random sample of user requests or a semantic quality estimate.
Negative source review does not establish product-wide absence of every possible implementation.

judgment_contract.positive: A result is a frozen hit only when path and symbol match one listed relevant source anchor.
judgment_contract.distractor: An explicitly inspected neighboring owner with a distinct operation is labeled separately; all other rows remain unjudged.
judgment_contract.negative: No relevant anchor is expected for the requested unsupported operation. Returned lexical candidates do not establish that capability.
judgment_contract.evidence: Anchor line bounds are one-based inclusive and source_excerpt preserves those exact snapshot lines.

relevant.source_excerpt:
def write_new_bytes(path: Path, body: bytes, *, mode: int = 0o600) -> None:
    """Publish one owned regular file and verify its final name and bytes."""
    if (os.name != "posix" or not hasattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW")
            or not isinstance(body, bytes) or mode not in {0o400, 0o444, 0o555, 0o600}):
        raise BenchmarkError("artifact_platform", "verified artifact publication requires POSIX")
    target = path.absolute()
    parent = target.parent
    if not target.name or target.name in {".", ".."}:
        raise BenchmarkError("artifact_path", "invalid artifact path")
    try:
        if parent.resolve(strict=True) != parent:
            raise BenchmarkError("artifact_path", "artifact parent must be canonical without links")
        parent_descriptor = os.open(
            parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    except BenchmarkError:
        raise
    except OSError as error:
        raise BenchmarkError("artifact_path", "cannot open artifact parent without links") from error
    descriptor = None
    owned = None
    published = False
    expected_parent = os.fstat(parent_descriptor)
    try:
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(expected_parent.st_mode):
            raise BenchmarkError("artifact_path", "artifact parent is not a directory")
        try:
            descriptor = os.open(
                target.name,
                os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK,
                mode,
                dir_fd=parent_descriptor,
            )
            published = True
        except FileExistsError as error:
            raise BenchmarkError("artifact_exists", f"artifact already exists: {target}") from error
        opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        owned = (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino)
        os.fchmod(descriptor, mode)
        with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(body)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        written = os.fstat(descriptor)
        named = os.stat(target.name, dir_fd=parent_descriptor, follow_symlinks=False)
        if (not stat.S_ISREG(written.st_mode) or stat.S_IMODE(written.st_mode) != mode
                or written.st_size != len(body) or not _same_node(written, named)):
            raise BenchmarkError("artifact_changed", "artifact changed during publication")
relevant.reason: This publishes using exclusive no-follow creation, rejects an existing target and verifies the named regular file.

distractors.reason: This validates JSON values rather than publishing output.
